positions.title: Associate Controls Specialist
positions.description: Skills: Human Machine Interface · AVEVA System Platform · Automation · Rockwell Studio 5000 · Variable-Frequency Drives (VFD)

positions.title: OT Co-op Engineer
positions.description:
• Helped oversee a conveyer installation project, with the Operations Technology team, by
correcting mistakes using the project schematic and creating wire and motor labels to easily
identify components.
• Lead morning pre-job safety meetings with contractors under the plant maintenance
engineer to ensure their tasks were done safely and to provide any help that would ease
their task.
• Helped design the electrical system for an automatic filtering screen changeout machine.
• Created AutoCAD schematics for panel layouts and wiring diagrams for industrial controls
implementations.
• Helped install and commission upgraded variable frequency drives for a shingle line.

positions.title: Co-op Engineer
positions.description:
•	Work alongside project engineers to improve different automation processes.
•	Help doing IT support projects.
•	Design the plan and execution of an updated plant-wide intercom system.
•	Design and execute proper wiring and programming for two palletizing Fanuc robots at the end of two production lines.
•	Design and execute proper wiring and programming for the integration of a Fanuc robot in a laser cutting automation.

positions.title: International Programs Assistant/Intern
positions.description:
• Help to plan, develop, and execute various short-term professional programs with an office staff.
• Assist with GTI-401 course by teaching and providing guidance to a small group of
international students from the class.
• Schedule program and logistics for programs in Spanish as well as planning and leading
cultural excursions for large groups.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was in charge of a monthly food drive to the homeless people in the area of El Viejo San Juan, Puerto Rico. Every first Saturday of each month I would organize a group of high school students to prepare and serve breakfast with the help of the Saint Francis of Assis Parish.
